script.title: The Mystery of Roopkund Skeleton Lake Explained
script.description: For decades, hundreds of human remains at Roopkund Lake in the Himalayas were believed to be from a single tragedy. Modern DNA analysis revealed a far more complex historical mystery. Here is what documented science discovered.

scenes.narration: Hundreds of skeletons rested in a Himalayan lake, until DNA revealed why.
In 1942, a forest ranger rediscovered the bones at Roopkund in Uttarakhand.
British authorities initially feared the remains belonged to an invading military force.
Studies revealed head injuries, caused by round objects from above.
Investigators believed a ninth-century pilgrimage party perished together during a sudden storm.
However, genome analysis of thirty-eight individuals completely disproved that single event theory.
The older group dated to 800 CE and shared typical South Asian ancestry.
The second group died around 1800 CE, including individuals with eastern Mediterranean and Southeast Asian ancestry.
DNA revealed why skeletons rested in this Himalayan lake, spanning a thousand years.
What do you think brought Mediterranean travelers to this high mountain lake?
